newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: Traders reported good demand for different grades at this week's Calcutta tea auction.
In all 73,593 packages including 3,675 of Darjeeling tea were on offer.
CTC clean and liquoring Assams were firm, traders said on Friday. Well made clean and liquoring mediums were dearer.

Dusts prices rose by two to four rupees. In Orthodox teas, Iranian shippers were less active, particularly for whole leaf, while CIS countries gave fair support and Gulf countries remained active buyers, mainly for broken grades. East European demand for whole leaf teas was firm.
